input.final_summary: There is no dedicated All Services route in the new app. Services appear as 15 root `/{slug}/` pages from `content/config/services/`, plus homepage (6 cards), mega menu (15 links), and footer (6 links). “View all services” points to `/full-service-amazon-agency/`, not a hub. content.text:
## 1. Dedicated All Services page?

**No (in the new app).** Observed: no `src/app/**/services/page.tsx` or `/services` route; only per-service pages via `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\app\(marketing)\[slug]\page.tsx` (`getService` + `ServicePageTemplate`).

**Legacy (WordPress backup):** index at `https://ecomgliders.com/services/` (slug `services`, title “Services”) — `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\backup\metadata\page-inventory.json` (~5084–5093). Also `services-2/` in sitemap backup.

---

## 2. How services are listed today

| Surface | What | Evidence |
|--------|------|----------|
| **Homepage** | Section `id: "services"`, **6 cards** with direct `href`s | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\homepage.json` (~321–383); UI `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\sections\services-section.tsx` |
| **Header mega menu** | **15 links** in 4 columns + CTA rail | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\navigation.json` (`megaMenus.services`, ~41–163); UI `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\layout\mega-menu-panel.tsx`, `header-nav.tsx`, `mobile-nav.tsx` |
| **“View all services”** | Not a hub — **`/full-service-amazon-agency/`** | `navigation.json` `footerLink` (~145–147); spec `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\obsidian\07-UX\Navigation-Footer-Spec.md` (~124) |
| **Footer** | **6 service links** (subset) | `navigation.json` `footer.columns` id `services` (~285–311); `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\layout\footer-main.tsx` |
| **Service detail pages** | `relatedServices` block on each service | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\services\service-page-template.tsx` (~213+) |

No “All Services” index comparable to `/case-studies/` or `/blog/`.

---

| Concern | Path |
|--------|------|
| Nav config | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\navigation.json` |
| Nav schema | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\domain\content\schemas\navigation.schema.ts` |
| Mega menu UI | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\layout\mega-menu-panel.tsx` |
| Header / mobile | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\layout\header-nav.tsx`, `mobile-nav.tsx`, `site-header.tsx` |
| Footer | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\layout\site-footer.tsx`, `footer-main.tsx` |
| Homepage services | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\homepage.json`; `services-section.tsx`; `homepage-section-renderer.tsx` |

| Sitemap | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\lib\seo\build-sitemap-entries.ts` (static routes + per-slug services; **no `/services/`**); `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\app\sitemap.xml\route.ts` |

---

## 5. Docs / plans on services index gap

- **`e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\docs\seo\REDIRECT-MAP.md`** (~35–36): `/services/` → “Requires confirmation”; proposed 301 only after live crawl; new app uses root slugs, not a services index.
- **`e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\docs\project\DECISIONS.md`**: risk note on unconfirmed `/services/` prefix redirects.
- **`e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\.cursor\plans\2026-09-02-navbar-mega-menu-redesign.md`**: “View all services” footer on mega menu; lists legacy “All Services” set — implemented as mega links + flagship footer, not a listing page.
- **`e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\.cursor\plans\homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md`**: keep six homepage service hrefs; avoid old `/services/#service_N` hash pattern.
- **`e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\obsidian\03-Architecture\Content-Architecture.md`** (~312): still references `app/services/[slug]/page.tsx` — **stale** vs actual `[slug]` route.

**Gap summary:** Legacy WP had `/services/`; new stack has hub-like discovery via mega menu + homepage subset, with “View all services” standing in for a true index at `/full-service-amazon-agency/`. No planned `/services/` listing page config found in `content/config/`.
